description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Rear Drive Shaft that goes from the Transfer Case to the Rear Differential
FITS ALL MODELS from 1980 thru 1995 (determined by flange size and spacer fitment on existing driveline)
Large and Small Bolt Pattern Flanges Included.
Simply install the Flange you require on Drive Shaft.
Recommend alternate u-joints as these may be tight
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Drive Shaft – 19″ length
Qty 2 – Small Bolt Pattern Flange 1980 – 1989
Qty 2 – Large Bolt Pattern Flange 1990 – 1995 attached
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Small Flange – Suzuki Samurai 1980 – 1989 All Models
Large Flange – Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
